## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a passing and a failing case for a check)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased"
- [ ] `docs/checks.md` regenerated if checks changed (`capalens-ia-check checks --format markdown > docs/checks.md`)
- [ ] Still read-only: no tool calls, no writes, no new network destinations
- [ ] No score, grade or weighting introduced
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
